channel.niche: the surprising science and hidden engineering behind everyday things: food, animals, the ocean, your own body, and the machines, roads and objects around you; why and how things really work, explained accurately
channel.audience: US viewers aged 16-40, curious, scroll fast, no science background needed
channel.voice_tone: friendly, confident, a little playful, never clickbait-false
channel.name: Ever Thought Why?
channel.how_made: How this was made: the script is researched and fact-checked with AI tools against open-access research (sources above when found), narrated by an AI voice, and edited with open-source software. Corrections from viewers are checked and credited.

voice.name: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural
voice._note: two narrators: a curious host (hook, wondering aloud, pause-and-guess, closing question) and an explainer; Kokoro first, the Edge voices are the fallback

publish.timezone_note: US Eastern. 12:00 ET = 22:30 IST, 19:00 ET = 05:30 IST
publish.bank_note: finished, audited videos wait in the GitHub 'video-bank' release; 7 days are kept ready (14 Nov 2026, user: time is never a concern, stack videos ahead), so slow high-quality renders never cost a slot; the publisher uploads only the next day's slots
publish._quality_note: 2 a day since 13 Nov 2026: the fastest-growing channels in our genre post 2-6 strong videos a week; a weak video to fill a slot costs more than it earns
